body:
Restacked: this PR now targets `feature/niw2-584-post-recording-toast` (#455) instead of `feature/niw2-578-prepare-screen`. The stack is #448 ← #458 ← #455 ← #457 ← #456.

Merge commit 24b4fa2f brings #455 (and, through it, #458) in — merge, no rebase or force push. Conflicts and how they were resolved, keeping both features:

- `library-detail-page.tsx`: #455's top-right "Your video is ready" card (`showCard` / `cardDismissedFor`, rendered through `StatusCardPortal`) replaces the inline panel, and the import of the deleted `WhereIsItGoingPanel` is gone. This PR's master tag, "Where is this going?" strip, "Copies from this master" panel and the shared `runner` stay as they were.
- `library-detail-page.test.tsx`: #455's card tests (Edit first; Open / Dismiss close it) replace the panel's "Not now" test, and now expect this PR's **Send to…** button to remain on the page after the card closes.
- `backlog/prepare-screen.md`: one description of the merged state (top-right card, master recording page, two-column Prepare) and one "How to validate".

`bun run verify` is green on the merged branch.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Answers to the findings in the review summary that have no inline thread:

- **Unused `prepare` messages (`prepareFor`, `prepareForHint`, `quickLabel`, `quickAria`, `quick*`):** obsolete. #456 removed them from `en.json`/`es.json` (merge `8f3eea4a` on `feature/niw2-586-background-toasts`), and none exists at the top of the stack.
- **`backlog/edit-state-indicators.md:104` still lists `library.originalPlayerNote`:** still applies, and `library.originalLabel` on line 103 is stale too. Both are being fixed on a follow-up branch above #464, and a reply here will name the commit.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Review summary finding "`edit-state-indicators.md:104` lists removed `library.originalPlayerNote`": fixed in [`7a3aac00`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/7a3aac00ec8b9987055dada42021419946c33bcb) on #471 (top of the stack). The doc now says `library.originalLabel` and `library.originalPlayerNote` no longer exist (NIW2-585, #457), and keeps the rows as the historical copy spec.
